column1: # Clauses of Clause 6 that state no rule an input can break, classified per
# `no-prohibition` names the positive fixture(s) in this suite that run and
# assert the clause's behaviour. Read against docs/ch6-hierarchy.html, 2026-09-24.

column3: Undeclared interconnects between module instances are supported when describing hierarchical structures. A signal appearing in the connection list of a module instantiation need not appear in any port declaration or discipline declaration (see 7.4). A permission; what makes an undeclared interconnect illegal (an unknown discipline on a mixed port) is 7.4 / F.2.1 and is rejected there (annex_f_resolution/unknown_discipline_mixed_port.va). Positive: lrm_6_5_7_2.va (runs, asserts 0.5 through the undeclared net).

In connection with the conditional generate construct, an implementation may choose to limit sweepable parameters to those that do not influence the structure of the circuit. Whether a structure-fixing parameter may be swept is the implementation's choice. Positive for the part that is required (a dc sweep of an ordinary parameter): dynamic_parameter_dc_sweep.va.

Elaboration is the process that occurs between parsing and simulation. It binds modules to module instances, builds the model hierarchy, computes parameter values, selects paramsets, resolves hierarchical names, establishes net connectivity, resolves disciplines, inserts connect modules, and prepares all of this for simulation. A definition; the ordering rules are 6.9.1-6.9.4. Positive: lrm_6_9.va.

The simulator shall internally combine them into a single analog block in the order they appear in the module description. ... If an analog block appears in a loop generate statement, the order in which the loop is unrolled during elaboration determines the concatenation order. An ordering every input satisfies. Positive: generate_two_loops.va, generate_loop_descending.va, ch05_analog_behavior/multiple_analog_blocks.va.

If a generate construct contains an instantiation of an overloaded paramset, paramset selection is performed after the generate construct has been evaluated. An ordering, not a restriction. Positive: paramset_selected_after_generate.va (one paramset name, two generated instances, two different members), h01_05_paramset_under_parameter_sweep.va.

Automatic insertion of connect modules is a post-elaboration operation, as first the disciplines of the various nets needs to be resolved. Discipline resolution can only occur after elaboration of the generate constructs once the connections of all nets have been resolved. It should also occur after the paramset selection as the choice for a particular module instantiation may affect the disciplines of the connected nets. An ordering of elaboration steps; no source text can break it. Positive: connect_insertion_follows_paramset_selection.va (one paramset name, two selections, inserted on one net and not the other).
